title: euphrasia officinalis f. eglandulosa
intro: Euphrasia officinalis f. eglandulosa, commonly known as the glandular-less Euphrasia, is a variety of the Euphrasia officinalis plant, a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. It is a perennial herb that grows in wetlands and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia officinalis f. eglandulosa include reducing eye inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and supporting immune function, due to its bioactive constituents such as iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
